first: les voisins du dessus font du bruit jusqu'à 2h du matin tous les soirs, je dors pu

tenant.situation: Les voisins du dessus font de la musique et marchent fort tard le soir, presque chaque nuit depuis un mois.

knows.when: de 23h à 2h, presque tous les soirs
knows.tried: cogné au plafond, laissé une note une fois

truth.problem: neighbour noise complaint, not a repair

judge: Replies in French, is sympathetic, and says noise is handled by the property manager, not as a maintenance repair.
Points the tenant to the manager (and a written log of dates and times) without asking repair-style questions.

tenant.situation: A car you don't recognise keeps parking in your assigned parkade stall.

knows.tried: left a note on the windshield

judge: Says this isn't a maintenance issue and points to the property manager, who handles parking and towing.
Stays polite and doesn't open a repair ticket for it.

tenant.situation: You'd like the living room painted a darker green instead of the beige. Nothing is damaged.

knows.own_paint: you'd be willing to do it yourself if allowed

judge: Explains that colour changes are a request for the property manager, not a repair, and tells the tenant to ask before painting themselves.
Friendly in tone, no ticket for a repair that doesn't exist.

first: my amazon package got stolen from the lobby

tenant.situation: Amazon says your package was delivered to the lobby yesterday afternoon, but it's gone.

knows.when: delivered yesterday around 3 pm per Amazon
knows.where: left on the lobby floor by the mailboxes
knows.tried: asked a neighbour, checked the mailroom

judge: Says it isn't a maintenance issue; suggests contacting Amazon and the property manager (who may have camera footage), and police if needed.
Doesn't invent a building policy or promise footage.

tenant.situation: You got a notice about a unit inspection but lost it and want to know the date.

knows.what: you think it's a smoke alarm or annual inspection

judge: Doesn't make up a date; says the property manager has the schedule and how to reach them.
Short and polite, no repair questions.

tenant.situation: Two things: the upstairs neighbours are loud every night, and today you found water dripping from a pipe under your bathroom sink.

knows.noise: music and stomping after 11 pm, most nights
knows.leak_where: under the bathroom sink, from the curved pipe
knows.leak_when: drips when you run the tap
knows.how_much: a small puddle in the cabinet

doesnt_know: which part of the pipe is loose

judge: Takes the leak as the maintenance ticket and handles it properly.
Briefly says the noise goes to the property manager separately, without mixing it into the repair ticket.
